methodology.testAttribution: A protocol test is attributed when its source directly mentions the ABI key, identifier-bounded name or wrapper key, signature, identifier-bounded operation id, or HTTP path; negative/economic/red-team depth additionally requires a nearby proof keyword. The gap reporter's own tests are excluded to avoid self-attribution.
methodology.liveAttribution: A successful verify domain is attributed only by an exact generated HTTP method/path match. Fork markers classify local-fork proof; other tracked verify artifacts classify Base Sepolia proof.
methodology.classificationPolicy: Mechanical gaps dominate; intentionally excluded/admin operations without live proof are unsafe on live network; writes require unit, workflow, and negative-path evidence; events require event-specific indexer tests.
